psh_from_status_check.name: psh_from_status_check
psh_from_status_check.value: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('draft', 'quotation_sent', 'awaiting_down_payment', 'in_progress', 'client_review', 'handover_sent', 'warranty', 'completed', 'cancelled')

projects_cancel_reason_check.name: projects_cancel_reason_check
projects_cancel_reason_check.value: ("projects"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "projects"."cancel_reason" IS NULL) OR ("projects"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

payments_state_check.name: payments_state_check
payments_state_check.value:
("payments"."status" = 'verified' AND "payments"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."verified_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("payments"."status" = 'rejected' AND "payments"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("payments"."status" = 'pending' AND "payments"."verified_at" IS NULL)
